da-non-sequitur.evidence: S↔P: the core identity tr_M(σ_iσ_j) = z² (i≠j) follows correctly from the two-step Markov peel in the prf, for any Markov parameter. The aux facts check by hand: e_i² = [2]e_i, (q−z)[2] = 1 under D, and tr(σ²) = hz+1 = (q⁴+1)/(q²+1). The statement block, however, carries content the prf never touches. First, the Jones normalisation and convention-D-uniqueness material (md:110-119, "Proved in JonesNormalisation.lean — … conventionD_iff_markov_invariant") is cited out, not proved here. Second, an empirical tie-in, md:127-128: "matching the empirically-verified all-pairs set on atoms $A \ge 6$". That is a remark-level empirical claim inside the proposition block. It should be moved to a remark.

trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 1 negation-contrast construction(s): ", not a length-3 word:" — state the positive claim directly

Proof read in full and re-derived. The two peels are correct: in H_{j+1} the rightmost generator is sigma_j and sigma_i lies in H_j, so tr^{H_{j+1}}(sigma_i sigma_j) = z tr^{H_j}(sigma_i); Markov closure then drops to H_{i+2}, where sigma_i is rightmost, giving z tr(1) = z; hence z^2. The adjacency-independence argument is also right — a length-2 word invokes no braid relation, and both stated conditions are indeed independent of |i-j|. All ten trap categories clean.
